item.title: South Korea’s top law exam scorer found dead amid AI fraud scandal
item.description: The man facing allegations of artificial intelligence-assisted cheating was found dead on Thursday after South Korean police began searching for him. Lee Jin-woo, a Seoul National University (SNU) dental student, had gone missing since the previous night after telling reporters he would dispel the cheating allegations by publicly demonstrating his abilities by solving College Scholastic Ability Test (CSAT) questions in a live stream on Thursday. item.title: Van Gogh painting sells for record US$190.4 million after dispute
item.description: A Vincent van Gogh painting has set a record after selling for US$190.4 million at a Sotheby’s auction in New York. At its first appearance at auction, the painting Chataigniers en fleurs (Blossoming Chestnut Trees) set the highest price a Van Gogh painting has sold for at auction and the second highest for any artwork sold at Sotheby’s. Gustav Klimt’s Portrait of Elisabeth Lederer holds that honour, sold a year ago at Sotheby’s for US$236.4 million. The Dutch artist painted the landscape scene...

item.title: Crackdowns failed to stop Southeast Asia’s scam centres. Here’s what advocates want next
item.description: Campaigners in Asia are taking advantage of the presence of global leaders in the region this week to urge governments to redouble efforts to uproot the scam centres whose bosses continue to swindle billions of dollars from hideouts in Myanmar and other parts of the Mekong.
